deposits.notes: World Values of AI, DOI 10.17605/osf.io/h9t7m. Found through the DataCite first-author search, not cited in the paper or form. DataCite names Alice Gao, Andrew N. Meltzoff, Maarten Sap, and Katharina Reinecke. The registration describes comparing no intervention, generalized AI-values feedback, and personalized value-comparison feedback during LLM-assisted writing; its listed outcomes include type-token ratio, AI reliance, and suggestion acceptance/modification. This is a strong thematic/author match to S1, but correspondence to the actual analyzed sample is unconfirmed: it plans three conditions, four writing tasks, and at least 150 participants, whereas the paper reports four conditions, two writing tasks, and 149 analyzed participants. No paper DOI is attached (article_doi=null). Registered 2025-09-10, public and not currently embargoed; the historical embargo_end_date is 2026-01-01. GET https://api.osf.io/v2/registrations/h9t7m/ returned HTTP 200 and public=true. The file-provider listing https://api.osf.io/v2/registrations/h9t7m/files/ returned HTTP 200 with osfstorage as the sole provider; https://api.osf.io/v2/registrations/h9t7m/files/osfstorage/ returned HTTP 200 with an empty list and total=0. The /children/, /resources/, and /linked_nodes/ endpoints also returned HTTP 200 with total=0. Public content consists of the registration questionnaire and planned methods, hence materials_only; there are no uploaded materials, data, code, scores, or participant essays. False arm_assignment means actual participant-to-arm records are absent, although planned conditions are described. The registration's registered_from relationship points to nonpublic project 7ufb9. License confirmed in https://api.datacite.org/dois/10.17605/osf.io/h9t7m (HTTP 200).

Underlying World Values of AI project linked by the public registration h9t7m and its DataCite metadata. The canonical web URL returned HTTP 200 but only the generic OSF application shell, not project contents. Anonymous GET https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/7ufb9/, https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/7ufb9/files/osfstorage/, and https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/7ufb9/children/ each returned HTTP 401 with detail 'Authentication credentials were not provided.' No login or access request was attempted. The empty files array means no accessible listing, not zero files. It is unknown whether this project contains participant data or whether account creation alone would permit access; project permission may also be necessary. Association with S1 is plausible from the linked preregistration but not definitively established; do not infer actual study randomization or dataset availability from the planned protocol. The public registration's license was not assumed to cover inaccessible project files.

notes: No public participant-level or output-level dataset with participant identifiers, assigned arms, and outcomes/texts was confirmed. The restricted label refers to the linked OSF project's authentication barrier, not confirmation that a participant dataset exists behind it; the only confirmed public repository content is a closely related preregistration with no files. The full 108953-character markdown conversion was read in six consecutive chunks through Appendix E, and PDF text/link annotations were checked across all 28 pages. Relevant quotations were extracted from PDF text with line breaks normalized to spaces. No formal data-availability statement, data-on-request offer, code-release statement, preregistration citation, or study-specific external repository link appears in the saved arXiv v1 manuscript. The described public study portal and external database have no supplied URL. Appendix A provides surveys, writing prompts, and interface examples; Appendices B-D provide aggregate demographic/results tables; Appendix E supplies a classification prompt and aggregate suggestion results, not participant records. The source form's data_url and code_url are empty, and it has no final object or final.open_items; no missing-statistics list was invented. Without individual data, the requested per-person means, SDs/SEs, outcome-specific analyzed counts, and participant-text diversity measures cannot be newly computed or checked. https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3805689.3812369 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge; no attempt was made to pass it, so publisher supplements remain unverified. https://doi.org/10.1145/3805689.3812369 returned HTTP 200 via JSON content negotiation to Crossref metadata, which supplied article HTML/PDF links and no related dataset. Both https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20512 and https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20512v1 returned HTTP 200; the current landing page lists only v1 (19 May 2026), has no ancillary-data link, and comments only 'Accepted to FAccT 2026'. The World Values Survey source cited in reference [38], https://doi.org/10.14281/18241.24, returned HTTP 404; this is an external instrument/source dataset, not this paper's participants, and was not counted as a c322 deposit. The article's https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 link returned HTTP 200; that article license does not establish a license for unobserved participant data. All network requests used Python urllib with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 and no email or personal identifier. Search results and repository metadata were inspected in memory; no data files were available to inspect. Checked 2026-10-09.
